description: Agent tools of the Gemini prediction market voice assistant. `tools` holds exactly the three backend tools, capture_order_intent, capture_cancel_intent and get_order_status: each is registered on the ElevenLabs agent as a client tool and implemented in the browser as a thin wrapper that forwards to the backend handler POST /tools/{name} (contracts/api.yaml). `market_tools` holds the two read-only market data tools, search_markets and get_orderbook: client tools that the browser forwards to GET /api/public/market-tools/{name}, which reads the Gemini Sandbox. Orders are prediction contracts only. No tool executes, routes or cancels anything; a capture is a record for later approval.

conventions.llm_parameters: The `parameters` object of each tool is everything the model supplies. Types are plain (no null unions). An optional parameter that is unknown is omitted; the wrapper sends it to the backend as null.
conventions.wrapper_envelope: The browser wrapper, never the model, adds session_id, last_transcript_seq and the Idempotency-Key header. Before forwarding, the wrapper flushes every pending transcript entry with POST /transcripts so the backend can check the readback and the spoken yes.
conventions.wrapper_return: The wrapper returns the backend JSON body to the model unchanged, serialized as a string, for success and for errors alike. On a network failure or timeout it retries once with the same Idempotency-Key, then returns {"ok":false,"simulated":true,"error":{"code":"backend_unavailable","message":"The capture service did not respond.","agent_hint":"Say you could not reach the service and ask the user to try again. Do not say anything was prepared."}}.
conventions.utterance: Each of the three backend tools takes `utterance`: the user's own words that stated this request, copied verbatim from the conversation as one unbroken stretch of user turns in spoken order, joined with single spaces when the request spanned several user turns. No paraphrase, no corrections, no agent words, no skipped user turn in the middle (api.yaml x-utterance-check requires a contiguous substring of the user transcript).
conventions.prices: Every price is an outcome price in US dollars per contract between 0 and 1, spoken in cents: buy.yes, buy.no, sell.yes, sell.no and limit_price. A price may be null, meaning none is available. No tool returns the price of an underlying asset.
conventions.identifiers: Tool results contain identifiers (intent.id, intent.session_id, intent_id, query_intent_id). They are not credentials. The agent passes an intent_id back as order_id when needed and never speaks any of them. The session token never appears in a tool parameter or result.
conventions.revision: 3.0.0: the two market tools moved to market_tools with new parameters and results, the chart tool and browser_tools are gone, and tools holds exactly the three backend capture tools. See x-revision in contracts/api.yaml.
conventions.simulated: The three capture tool responses still carry a field named simulated with value true. It means only that the capture API executes nothing; it says nothing about market data. Market data comes from the Gemini Sandbox through market_tools and is never called simulated.

error.code: string, one of the tool's error codes
error.agent_hint: string, what the agent should do next

conventions.market_data: search_markets and get_orderbook are the only source of market facts. They read the Gemini Sandbox through the application server (api.yaml x-market-data). event_ticker is events[].ticker, contract_symbol is events[].contracts[].symbol, and an order's instrument is that contract symbol.
conventions.states: Three states are kept apart: captured (prepared for approval, from the capture tools and get_order_status), sandbox account status (reported by the application, not by any tool here) and exchange execution (never). See api.yaml x-execution-boundary.

tools.name: capture_order_intent
tools.description: Record a fully specified limit order for a Gemini prediction contract for later approval. Prediction contracts only: a spot pair such as BTCUSD cannot be ordered. Captures only; nothing is sent to Gemini. Call this only when the previous agent turn was the exact readback of these terms ending with 'Say yes to confirm.' and everything the user said after it was an explicit spoken yes with no question, correction or negation. Never call it with a guessed instrument, quantity or price.

venue.description: Always gemini_prediction. Orders are prediction contracts only.

instrument.description: The contract's symbol exactly as search_markets returned it in this conversation (events[].contracts[].symbol). Never built, shortened or guessed, and never a spot pair.

side.description: yes or no, meaning buy contracts of that outcome. buy and sell are not sides.

quantity.description: The whole number of contracts the user stated.

limit_price.description: The limit price the user stated, in US dollars per contract, 0.01 to 0.99 (62 cents is 0.62). Never a price of the underlying asset.

confirmed_by_user.description: True only when the user just said yes to the readback of exactly these terms. The backend verifies this against the transcript.

utterance.description: The user's verbatim words that stated the order.

validation: Parameters match the schema above, else invalid_parameters.
instrument is a contract symbol the Gemini Sandbox knows, else unknown_instrument. A spot pair or an invented string is unknown_instrument.
venue is gemini_prediction and side is yes or no, else invalid_parameters.
quantity is an integer of at least 1, else invalid_quantity (or invalid_parameters when the schema already rejects it).
limit_price is 0.01 to 0.99 in 0.01 steps, else invalid_price (or invalid_parameters when the schema already rejects it).
confirmed_by_user is true, else confirmation_required.
Transcript confirmation enforcement passes (api.yaml x-confirmation-enforcement): confirmation_missing, readback_missing, readback_interrupted, readback_mismatch, confirmation_already_used.
utterance is found in the user's transcript (api.yaml x-utterance-check), else utterance_mismatch.

duplicate.description: True when this call repeated an already captured confirmation and the original intent is returned unchanged.

tools.name: capture_cancel_intent
tools.description: Record a request to cancel one specific prediction contract order for later approval. Captures only; nothing is cancelled on Gemini. Call this only when the previous agent turn was the exact cancel readback ending with 'Say yes to confirm.' and everything the user said after it was an explicit spoken yes with no question, correction or negation. order_id must be an intent_id returned by get_order_status or a capture tool in this conversation, or a reference the user spoke aloud. Never invent or complete an order ID.

venue.description: Always gemini_prediction. Only prediction contract orders can be cancelled.

order_id.description: Either the intent_id of a prepared order from this session, or the order reference exactly as the user spoke it (letters and digits joined, for example AB12345).

instrument.description: Contract symbol of the order when known, exactly as search_markets or get_order_status returned it. Omit when the user identified the order by reference only.

confirmed_by_user.description: True only when the user just said yes to the readback of exactly this cancel.

utterance.description: The user's verbatim words that asked for the cancel.

validation: Parameters match the schema above, else invalid_parameters.
order_id is normalized (upper case, alphanumerics only) unless it is the id of an intent in this session.

If order_id is the id of a place_order intent of this session: instrument, when given, must equal that intent's instrument (instrument_mismatch) and is filled from it when omitted; a second cancel for the same target is rejected with cancel_already_captured. venue is always gemini_prediction; a legacy target on another venue is venue_mismatch.
If order_id is the id of an intent that is not a place_order, the error is order_not_cancellable.

Otherwise order_id must appear, after reference normalization, in the user's own transcript entries of this session, else order_id_not_user_supplied. The reference is recorded as stated and is not checked against Gemini. A reference that normalizes to the empty string is order_id_not_user_supplied. When instrument is given with a spoken reference it must be a contract symbol the Gemini Sandbox knows, else unknown_instrument.
confirmed_by_user is true, else confirmation_required.
Transcript confirmation enforcement passes (api.yaml x-confirmation-enforcement).
utterance is found in the user's transcript, else utterance_mismatch.

tools.name: get_order_status
tools.description: Look up what has been captured in this session: prepared prediction contract orders and prepared cancels. It reports capture status only. It never asks Gemini, so it knows nothing about the sandbox account or the exchange. Use it for status questions and to find the target of a cancel described in words. Needs no confirmation.

venue.description: Always gemini_prediction. Only prediction contract orders are prepared, so there is nothing to look up on spot.

order_id.description: An intent_id from this conversation or a complete reference the user spoke. Omit to list by description. Never send punctuation, filler or a partial reference.

instrument.description: Filter by exact contract symbol. Omit for any.

side.description: Filter by side. Omit for any.

utterance.description: The user's verbatim words that asked the question.

validation: Parameters match the schema above, else invalid_parameters.
order_id that is not the id of an intent in this session and normalizes to the empty string (upper case, alphanumerics only) is invalid_parameters.

Only place_order intents of the calling session on gemini_prediction are searched. Filters combine with AND. An instrument filter that matches no captured order returns nothing and is not an error. order_id matches an intent id exactly, or, after reference normalization, never matches a prepared order (user references are not known to the capture store).

utterance that is not found in the user's transcript is replaced by the latest non-empty user transcript entry, cut to 2000 characters; the call does not fail. If the session has no user speech at all the call is refused with utterance_mismatch and nothing is stored (api.yaml x-audit-records).

execution.description: Nothing has been sent to Gemini. Every match is a capture awaiting approval.

cancel_captured.description: True when a cancel_order intent for this prepared order has also been captured.

query_intent_id.description: id of the order_status intent written for this query.

market_tools.name: search_markets
market_tools.description: Find Gemini prediction market events and their contracts in the Gemini Sandbox, a test environment. Pass key words of the event or topic, or an empty string to list the active events. Returns events, each with a ticker, a title and contracts; each contract has a symbol, a label, an expiry and buy and sell prices for yes and no in dollars per contract, any of which may be null. Use an event's ticker as event_ticker and a contract's symbol as contract_symbol and as an order's instrument.

query.description: Key words of the event or topic, such as 'bitcoin' or 'fed'. Every word must match, so use few. An empty string lists the active events.

validation: Exactly one parameter, query, a string of at most 200 characters. Anything else is 400 'Invalid market tool parameters.'.

Matching and limits are in api.yaml x-market-data: every word must be a substring of the event title, category or ticker or the contract symbol or label; at most 8 events with at most 8 contracts each.
Read only. No utterance, no venue, no confirmation, no audit intent, no transcript entry.

market_tools.name: get_orderbook
market_tools.description: Get a fresh Gemini Sandbox quote for one prediction contract: its buy and sell prices for yes and no in dollars per contract, any of which may be null. It is a quote, not a depth book. event_ticker is the event's ticker and contract_symbol is the contract's symbol, both copied exactly from a search_markets result in this conversation.
validation: Exactly two parameters, both strings of at most 200 characters made of letters, digits, underscore, dot and hyphen. Anything else is 400.
An event or contract the sandbox does not have is 404 'Prediction contract unavailable for this event.'.
Read only. No utterance, no venue, no confirmation, no audit intent, no transcript entry.
